title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the paint-standard fan. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Paint standard
options.thesis: The project baseline is the official chip. Accept replaces that chip.
options.viewport: A state-colored top bar, an equal-height shot list, and the screenshot on a notched chip. Accept is a normal button.
options.risk: The yellow shell reads as a warning banner if the notch is small.

raised.raise: Zoo map: the shell is one flat color field for the current state, not a tint on grey.
Character catalog: every shot in the list is the same height cell.
Monochrome marketing: a count never appears without the frame it describes.

options.label: Contact sheet
options.lineage: darkroom contact sheet and grease pencil
options.thesis: The run is a sheet of frames. The one you circle becomes the baseline.
options.viewport: A dark sheet, frames in a tight grid, one circled in red, with Accept beside that circle.
options.risk: Familiar. A lot of visual-diff tools already feel like a film strip.

options.label: Botanical folio
options.lineage: one plant, five plates, one scale
options.thesis: Baseline, actual, and diff stay the same size on one ground, like plates of one plant.
options.viewport: Three registered frames on one baseline, captions under each, standard tabs to switch.
options.case: Holds clarity for compare. Weaker identification than a chip you are allowed to replace.
options.risk: Five life stages do not exist in this product. Only three frames do.

options.label: Grid specimen
options.thesis: The construction grid stays visible so alignment is the review, not a hidden system.
options.viewport: A visible cell grid behind a normal shot list and one large frame snapped to cells.
options.case: Designers recognize it. The grid is density, not a new way to navigate.
options.risk: A visible grid can fight the screenshot instead of serving it.

options.label: Split-flap board
options.thesis: Runs are timed rows. A state change ticks through, then the row settles.
options.viewport: A normal project table in condensed caps. The selected row ticks once when review state changes.
options.case: Clear for a run list. Weak once the job is a screenshot.
options.risk: A flap costume would hide the image. The tick has to stay a small move.

options.label: Zoo guide map
options.case: Loses identification and clarity. Lobe navigation is not this task.
options.kept: One flat color owns the shell.

options.label: Character catalog
options.case: Screenshots are not characters. Loses both axes.
options.kept: The list is whole cells of one height.

options.label: Neutral product page
options.thesis: One accent, every claim next to a screenshot.
options.viewport: Claim, then proof, down the page.
options.case: This is the category default the operate rules refuse as a palette.
options.kept: A count never appears without the frame it describes.
options.risk: Indistinguishable from the last ten review tools.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A quiet neutral review app, played straight.
canonCard.viewport: Left list, large compare, accept on the right, blue primary.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
